title: Second-round code reads for a9quant-strategy
goal: Read the current must_read_next code files for /root/a9quant-strategy and extract implementation evidence before any owner-doc reverse-writing.
scope: Only inspect the eight phase-1 must_read_next files and summarize what is already implemented
and what this implies for owner-doc writing; do not run phase-2 and do not write files in the target project.

acceptance.text: Evidence summary captures the current implementation status across the eight must_read_next files for /root/a9quant-strategy

key_updates: Second-round evidence reads confirm that the target project already has real risk, engine, ws bridge, market data, and oms implementations instead of concept-only placeholders.
advanced_risk.py implements a persistent capital-based RiskManager with policy evaluation, mode transitions, and approve_action gates shared by strategy engines.

ccxt_utils.py implements a concrete exchange adapter for Bitget and CCXT, including market inspection, leverage and margin-mode setup, position fetch, close-position flow, and contract balance queries.
decisions: Owner-doc reverse-writing for /root/a9quant-strategy must describe an already-implemented trading architecture, not a greenfield design-only project.
Phase 2 should wait for one more evidence pass over main_controller, account_state, contracts, and selected tests before writing owner docs.
risks: The current evidence still lacks main_controller, account_state, contracts, and test-layer confirmation, so phase-2 writing would still risk overstating the implemented mainline.
ccxt_utils.py contains hard-coded Bitget sandbox credentials in its __main__ test block, which is a real hygiene and security risk even if they are non-production.
verification: Read advanced_risk.py in three chunks and confirmed RiskManager, policy state machine, and approve_action implementation.
Read ccxt_utils.py in four chunks and confirmed ExchangeTrader margin, leverage, positions, close-position, and balance helper implementation.

Read previously selected must_read_next files bitget_ws_bridge.py, market_data_hub.py, tiny_oms.py, trend_engine.py, shark_engine.py, and base_bitget_ws.py to confirm ws/data/oms/engine layers are already implemented.
next_steps: Run one more evidence pass on main_controller.py, account_state.py, contracts.py, and high-value tests before phase-2 owner-doc writing.
Keep /root/a9quant-strategy in phase-1 plan mode; do not write owner docs yet.

conflict_policy.escalation_rule: if conflict remains, escalate to run-main
